name: 1Password
description: Resolve 1Password secrets in-process into the OpenClaw shared store, and expose 1Password vault/item tools to agents.

op.description: Advanced/optional. Resolves op:// references via a child node resolver. Subject to the exec secret sandbox — requires egress allowlisting to reach the 1Password API. Prefer the in-process store sync for most setups.

serviceAccountTokenEnvVar.description: Name of the environment variable holding the 1Password service account token.

integrationName.description: Integration name reported to the 1Password SDK for audit logs.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-operation timeout for 1Password SDK calls, in milliseconds.

syncOnStartup.description: Fetch the configured `secrets` mapping from 1Password and write it into the OpenClaw store when the gateway starts.

failFastOnStartup.description: If true, a startup sync failure throws and prevents the gateway from starting. If false, the plugin logs the error and lets last-known-good store values be used.

secrets.description: Map of OpenClaw store key -> 1Password secret reference (op://Vault/Item[/Section]/Field). Store keys must match ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$.
